prompt: Arrange the steps of an in-place Redis Software cluster upgrade performed one node at a time, starting with the master node.
explanation: Every node gets a pre-check (rlcheck plus rladmin status extra all), then the new package is extracted and `sudo ./install.sh` re-run — the script detects the existing installation and upgrades in place. The node is re-verified before moving on, and the cluster's master node is upgraded first. Upgrading all nodes at once, or skipping the per-node health checks, is what the upgrade procedure is designed to prevent.

options.text: Run rlcheck and rladmin status extra all; do not proceed while anything is not OK
Repeat for every remaining node, one at a time
Re-verify the node with rlcheck and rladmin status extra all
Extract the downloaded installation package with tar vxf
Run sudo ./install.sh, which detects the existing installation and upgrades it
